tldr: The squared distance between counterfactual densities has zero first-order gradient at equality. On the original fixed rough observed-law class, the exact-null minimax expected length of intervals honest over the full class is of order \(n^{-16/29}\), with no logarithmic factor. The explicit data-only interval in Theorem~\ref{thm:sharp-frontier} combines normalized histogram pilots, independent multiband coefficient corrections and finite-sample scalar inversion. Its coverage holds at every finite sample size, and its expected length attains the minimax order at every equality law, including arbitrary non-flat common densities. The construction handle names this selected interval and rate; attainment is up to universal positive multiplicative constants for sufficiently large sample sizes.
gap: \cite{KennedyBalakrishnanWasserman2023Density}, Section 5.2, identifies the equality failure of ordinary density-effect Wald inference. The earlier banked proposal leaves a rough-null lower and upper bracket rather than a match. Fixed-kernel testing and regularized Hilbert confidence sets do not settle the stated scalar honest-length criterion.
fill: A matched upper and lower theorem must jointly certify non-flat-null coefficient means, sparse-cell covariance, public failure budgets and actual-law mixture affinity. A narrow fixed-smoothness theorem can close the documented retry gap without an unsupported all-regime claim.
